key_idea: A single swap flips permutation parity, so the swap graph is bipartite; the largest swap-free set is a maximum independent set = N - maximum matching (Konig).
sketch: Build edges between words differing in exactly two positions (anagrams with distinct letters, so two mismatches is exactly one swap), O(N^2 * len). 2-colour the graph by BFS (or by permutation parity), run Kuhn's augmenting-path matching from one side, answer N - matching. With N=500 Kuhn is far within limits. Pitfall: treating it as a general-graph independent set, or not noticing bipartiteness.
